text_blocks.snippet: While no cancer is 100% avoidable, many cancers can be prevented or their risk reduced through lifestyle choices and other interventions. Approximately 4 in 10 cancer cases and deaths in the US are linked to modifiable risk factors. This means that by making conscious choices about our health, we can significantly lower our chances of developing cancer, according to the American Cancer Society.
Here's a breakdown of how cancer can be avoided or its risk reduced:
